name: Louise Watson
title: Strategic communications consultant and executive advisor
bio_short: Strategic communications consultant with 25 years' experience. Led EMEA teams at Ogilvy, Weber Shandwick and H+K Strategies for P&G, Shell, Nestlé, Unilever, Mastercard and British Airways. Trained more than 1,000 senior leaders. UK-based.
bio: Louise is a strategic communications consultant with 25 years' experience leading global consumer business across FMCG, retail, health, technology, energy and travel. She has held senior roles at Ogilvy, Weber Shandwick and H+K Strategies, where she led teams across EMEA for clients including Procter and Gamble, Shell, Nestlé, Unilever, Mastercard, Kellogg's, British Airways, Bayer and Avis Budget Group. She has trained more than 1,000 senior leaders and authored official guidance on the effective use of communications to build organisational resilience.  Louise specialises in content and channel planning across owned and earned media, reputation management and integrated content distribution. Her client experience extends to UK government work in national security and defence, giving her breadth that spans consumer brands and highly sensitive institutional communications.  At ISOC, Louise delivers corporate communications, social media, AI and digital communications and content strategy programmes. Her agency pedigree and global brand experience make her particularly effective at helping organisations develop integrated communications strategies that work across multiple channels and markets. She is current on developments in AI-powered communications tools, making her a relevant and forward-looking trainer for organisations navigating digital transformation. Louise is based in the UK and trains in English.
